title: CAPEX Sub-Lines Schema + Repository Skeleton
purpose: Implement the schema + repository skeleton for user-added CAPEX sub-lines, per the 57A-9A design gate (PR #505, MERGED). Adds the capex_sub_lines table, the app/persistence/capex_sub_lines.py module (record, validators, mapping, factory guard, aggregation helpers, DB-backed helpers), and 104 new tests. Does NOT wire save/load, Run, Excel export, or update_scenario_overrides (all deferred to 57A-9C/9D/9E).
status: DRAFT — runtime + migration, NOT auto-merge eligible

files_changed.rationale: Add idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS capex_sub_lines + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_capex_sub_lines_project. Existing tables unchanged.

New persistence helper module: CapexSubLine dataclass, CAPEX_CATEGORY_TO_FIELD mapping (locked), ALLOWED_PARENT_CATEGORIES + REJECTED_PARENT_CATEGORIES sets, pure validators (validate_parent_category, validate_business_code), pure counter (generate_next_business_code, gap-preserving), factory project guard (assert_project_allows_capex_sub_lines), pure aggregation helpers (resolve_effective_sub_line_amount with REPLACE-not-delta semantic, fold_sub_lines_into_capex with factory no-op and C.08/C.11 additive into audit_legal), DB-backed helpers (list_sub_lines_for_project, list_business_codes_for_project, create_sub_line, soft_delete_sub_line). No imports from UI / static / run / export / model / waterfall / factories.

104 new tests pinning: schema, columns, idempotent migration, existing tables unchanged, UNIQUE/FK constraints, index, UUID stability, business code format, gap-preserving counter, C.01..C.16 allowed, C.17/C.18 rejected, unknown categories rejected, locked mapping, every field exists on CapexStructure, C.08 + C.11 fold additively into audit_legal, override REPLACES default (Claude delta review fix), factory project guard (PermissionError), factory no-op in fold, soft-deleted excluded, no production code changed, rc1 frozen.
Design + change doc with goals, non-goals, schema, mapping, aggregation rule, files-changed, files-not-changed, hard no-go, phase plan, stop-and-document.

aggregation_rule.semantics: scenario override REPLACES default (NOT a delta adjustment)
aggregation_rule.formula: effective_amount_keur = override_amount_keur if override_amount_keur is not None else default_amount_keur
aggregation_rule.factory_no_op_rationale: Empty user_sub_lines returns capex unchanged. TUHO / Oborovo / Generic Solar / Generic Wind parity preserved by construction.

validate_parent_category.rejected_message: C.17 and C.18 are read-only in the CAPEX catalogue and do not accept user-added sub-lines

validate_business_code.u_prefix_rationale: Disjoint namespace from template C.NN.NN codes (57A-5B canonical catalogue)

phase_plan.57A-9C: Save / Load (runtime, DRAFT, gated on review)

hard_no_go: no_factory_project_mutation (factory guard is NOT wired into any route/handler in 57A-9B)
no_57a8_in_memory_preview_regression (toolbar, tmp marker, badge, warning block, preview-only totals all preserved)
